searchText: Hey all, feel somewhat ashamed... How do I run the `consume-engine` tests? I get this error I run `./hive --sim eest --sim.limit consume-engine --client ethereumjs --docker.output`. `Dockerfile.local` has been renamed to `Dockerfile` so I'm running my local branch I'm on hive master @ `538045cb563a2d68053abb527f75d59988dde438` We've been doing this ``` ./hive --sim "ethereum/eest/consume-engine" --client "besu" --sim.buildarg fixtures=https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/download/pectra-devnet-5%40v1.3.0/fixtures_pectra-devnet-5.tar.gz --client.checktimelimit=60s --sim.parallelism=4 -sim.limit tests/prague ``` Hey great, that works 🙂 This will limit it to the `tests/prague` directory right? How did you construct this command? It was actually <@761154847432769577> that constructed it, think he took inspiration from https://github.com/ethpandaops/pectra-devnets/actions/runs/12807817870/job/35709210009 I wrote down an idea on how to create a new fixture format to validate (to some degree) block production: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/discussions/1143 Input from the EL devs would be greatly appreciated 🙏
